draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.30, the 56th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 9th of 32 at WR. He went 69th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Darnell Mooney. Testing standouts: 10-yard split (88th percentile). College production: his final season (2022) ranked 1st in receiving yards among the 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Houston Texans (reserve / out). 25 career games and 18 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 6 AV in 2024. Weak spots: drop rate 7.4% (15th percentile), yards after catch per reception 3.2 (23rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 wide receiver who played: 667 receiving yards against a median of 290, above the norm.
